name: Almedíjar (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, red above with a yellow tower between two laurel branches and green below.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 18 January 2005 of the conseller de Justícia i Administracions Públiques, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana no. 4944 of 11 February 2005; it is a flag of 2:3, divided per half in the height, with the tower of the arms (approved 18 April 2000), which refers to the ancient fortress of Almedíjar, with two laurel branches.

features.role: tower above two laurel branches, the figures of the arms
